statement_summary: CySO and alternate designated in writing; reachable 24x7
Annual risk assessment as part of the Cybersecurity Assessment
Risk acceptance authority; no acceptance of High safety or TSI risks
Security criteria in procurement; vendor notification of vulnerabilities and incidents
Cyber records kept at least 2 years and protected
Unique accounts; no shared gate logins; separate credentials on IT and OT
Least privilege; separate administrator accounts
MFA for all identity provider users, VPN, cloud admin and remote OT access
Same-day account and PACS removal at termination
Change default passwords before use; minimum password strength
Vendor remote access per session with MFA and recording; OT remote access off by default
Physical access to OT and related IT equipment limited and logged
Cyber Incident Response Plan and ransomware runbook
Report suspected incidents to the CySO within 1 hour
Immediate report to the FBI, CISA and the Captain of the Port
Stop OT in a safe state when controller integrity is in doubt
Annual exercise; cyber scenario in the MTSA exercise
Cybersecurity planning documents handled as SSI
Encryption in transit; no plain FTP
Inventory of network-connected systems with critical IT and OT designated
Isolated backups of critical IT and OT restore-tested quarterly
Central logs accessible only to privileged users; 1-year retention
Cyber training within 5 days of access and annually; OT module
Untrained users accompanied or monitored
Approved hardware and software only; no personal USB or laptops on OT or gate systems
No SSI or cargo data in public generative AI tools
